name: same-account-failure-burst
condition: 5 or more failed logins for the same account from the same source address within 120 seconds
evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1110 covers repeated password guessing against an account.

name: same-source-failure-burst
condition: 8 or more failed logins from the same source address within 120 seconds, without a repeated credential signal
evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1110 covers repeated login attempts used to guess credentials.

name: credential-spray
condition: The same non-reversible credential fingerprint is reported for 3 or more accounts from one source address within 300 seconds
evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1110.003 describes password spraying across multiple accounts.
